text: {"lessons":["Selling winners just because they are profitable can cut short their potential; I should base each trade on its future prospects, not the comfort of locking in a gain.","A losing position is not automatically a mistake to hold, and a winning position is not automatically safe to sell; I should review risk and expected return without anchoring on my average cost.","After a large account-value decline, I should check whether my overall exposure and cash fit my risk tolerance, rather than reacting to the loss or assuming a rebound is due."]}
